findings.evidence:
In MainViewModel.kt, startRecording() initiates a continuous AudioRecord read loop inside a viewModelScope. This loop is not tied to the activity lifecycle and can remain active when the app is minimized without an explicit user-facing recording indicator.

**Critic Verification**: MainViewModel.kt at line 463 verifies that startRecording() launches a continuous audio read loop using viewModelScope. This scope outlives the Activity UI lifecycle and can continue recording and transmitting audio silently in the background without a Foreground Service, verifying the policy violation. (Confidence: High)
findings.recommendation: Tie the recording loop to the app's UI lifecycle to pause capture when minimized, or ensure the ongoing recording is backed by a Foreground Service with an explicit 'recording in progress' notification.

findings.evidence:
MainViewModel.kt contains loginWithEmail and guestLogin methods. MainActivity.kt contains Google and Apple Sign-In implementations.

**Critic Verification**: MainViewModel.kt implements loginWithEmail and guestLogin methods. MainActivity.kt implements Google and Apple sign-in flows. The app contains a login wall and therefore requires demo credentials and an account deletion link per Play Store policy. (Confidence: High)
findings.issue_summary: App displays or contains a login screen, registration wall, or authentication interface.
findings.recommendation:
Administrative Console Requirements: Because your app implements a login flow, you MUST complete two manual setup steps in the Play Console dashboard to pass review:
1. Reviewer Demo Credentials: Submit active, non-expiring test credentials so Google Play reviewers can access your gated features.
2. Account Deletion Link: Submit a public-facing web link for account deletion to satisfy Google Play's data deletion policies.

findings.evidence:
In CameraPreview.kt, imageAnalysis continuously captures frames every 1.5 seconds and calls viewModel?.sendFrame(base64) which transfers the frames off-device via maveSessionManager.sendEvent without an affirmative prominent disclosure gatekeeper.

**Critic Verification**: CameraPreview continuously captures and transfers frames off-device via the ViewModel and maveSessionManager every 1.5 seconds without any visible prominent disclosure gatekeeper. (Confidence: High)
findings.issue_summary: Silent Background Transfer: Policy violation. Data is sent without prior disclosure.
findings.recommendation: Implement a prominent disclosure dialog before the CameraPreview is initialized, explicitly stating that camera frames are continuously collected and sent to the server for music generation, and require affirmative user consent.
